name: Daniel Seetoh
biography: Daniel Seetoh currently works on the development of SquareX's browser extension and web app. With a focus on the frontend, Daniel brings a versatile skillset that augments his approach towards cybersecurity. He has earned his degrees from Nanyang Technological University, and enjoys building out products and providing value to users.
